decisions.proposition: Implement Fix B1 (leading-byte region base first_entry_addr - first_entry_off gated on E0 RegionMatch of [0,k), zero overlap/foreign entry, branch analysis using physical table_start) and Unified Fix B2 inside the single derived PlacementPlan: keep extern symbolic rel32 for exported entries; emit remaining cross-object ASM relative branches (B2-interior, B2-entry, B2-span, and rel32-interior such as 0x2f6df with zero M2 OMF PUBDEF synthesis) via NASM piece-local label expressions (preferred, using decoded next_ip = ia + insn.size and typed encodings with assembled-byte verification) or verified literal displacement fallback, requiring verified original target identity, zero intersecting relocation over fixed displacement fields, and physical adjacency for every live cross-piece fallthrough per DEC-A05 r2, strictly rejecting any span containing a global --legacy or automatic per-object Unplaceable legacy-placed object (DEC-B19 r2), recording Build A placement debt, and requiring IntegratedResult with hardened wc1.compare (DEC-A03 r2). Qualify IntroOpSyncSound standalone regression tests by mode: rejected under legacy or B2-disabled, accepted only with explicit B2-span debt under in-place B2, zero debt as Group B.
decisions.note: Re-confirms ACCEPT on DEC-C05 rev 4 (5d51b22b...). Confirms Architect B as RFC Editor under B Round 6 conditions (1)-(6).

objections.basis: Unchanged from Round 6 (aligned with originator Architect B Round 6 RESOLVED): unanimous DEC-A02 r2, DEC-C02 r2, DEC-A14 r1, and rejected DEC-C03 r1 close the production architectural objection (asserting architecture agreement + agreed future cutover test, not executed test), while the forensic root cause of CONST padding variance stays in the RFC deferred-questions table (excluded by DEC-A02/DEC-A14; reopens only if pad variance blocks a named exact reconstruction or is needed for a justified B3/CONST-gap decision).
